desc:
Drupal site development from scratch gives you a new site built around the people who will edit it. Ecom Swift LLC installs the current Drupal release on your hosting, creates your content types and roles, and delivers a branded site with an editor guide.

## What is Drupal site development from scratch?

Drupal site development from scratch means building a new Drupal website from a clean installation, with the structure designed for your content and your team. Instead of adapting a copy of someone else's site, we create the content types, editor roles, menus and theme that fit what you publish. Typical content types include news, events, team profiles, resources and landing pages.

Drupal suits organizations that publish a lot, have several contributors or need fine control over who can change what. The cost of that power is that it must be set up with care.

## Why an editor-first build matters

Many Drupal sites are built for launch day and become painful by month three. Editors cannot find the right form, pages break when fields are left empty, and every small change needs a developer. The site slowly goes stale because updating it is hard.

Building around editors avoids this. Each content type has only the fields that matter, labeled in plain words. Each role sees the tools it needs and nothing more. A simple approval flow means a draft can be reviewed before it appears publicly. The site stays current because keeping it current is easy.

## How a good build affects results

An easy site gets updated, and an updated site gives visitors a reason to return. Structured content types let the same news item appear on the home page, in a listing and in search, entered only once. Good fields for titles, summaries and images help search engines and social sharing.

Visitors benefit from clear menus, consistent page layouts and fast pages on phones. For your team, results are measured in time saved and mistakes avoided. We cannot promise traffic or enquiries, but we can give you a foundation that does not hold you back.

## What a strong Drupal site includes

- The current Drupal release installed on your own hosting.
- A clean theme with your logo, colors and fonts.
- Content types designed for what you publish, with sensible fields.
- Listing pages and filtered views, such as events by date or staff by department.
- Main menu and footer menus planned around how visitors look for things.
- Editor and reviewer roles with fitting permissions.
- A draft, review and publish workflow where your team needs one.
- A contact form and basic SEO fields for titles and descriptions.
- A media library for images and documents.
- A launch checklist and an editor guide.

## What we do

We begin with a short brief: what you publish, who edits, and what visitors should do. We install Drupal on your hosting, set up the theme and build the agreed pages and content types. We create the roles and the approval flow, test each by logging in as that user, and review everything on desktop and phone.

The Basic package delivers a branded site with core pages, one content type and one editor role. Standard adds more pages and content types, menus, a reviewer role and a contact form. Premium provides a full editorial site with filtered views, a draft to publish workflow, a media library and training material. You see everything first on a private staging link, then we launch and hand over.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Gather your logo, colors, text and photos before we begin.
- List the types of content your team publishes regularly.
- Name who will write, who will review and who will publish.
- Use the staging link to try editing a page yourself.
- Plan hosting that meets Drupal's requirements.

**Avoid:**
- Adding fields for information you may never enter.
- Giving every editor administrator access.
- Building complex layouts for one page only.
- Launching before content is ready.
- Choosing hosting only on price.

## Who this is for

This suits a nonprofit or association that publishes news and events and has several volunteers editing. It suits a company that needs a structured site with profiles or resources, and an organization leaving a platform that restricts its content.

## What we need from you

Send your brand materials, a rough list of pages and the content you plan to publish. Tell us where the site will be hosted and who will edit it. We work as a developer or administrator user in your hosting and Drupal account, and we never ask for your password. After you order, a short checklist comes back from us.
